items.html: And the answer to this is: what is said in another place, that the lowest degree of the upper world is greater than everything below it, is not in the value of quantity and a bounded measure of place, but only in the aspect of the quality of the light itself, which is more superior than everything below it; and in the aspect of its quality and value, it includes everything below it. And the parable for this: we see that the last drop that is in the brain of a man includes everything that is below it, in the entirety of the human body. And even so, we see that in the aspect of the measure of place it is not so; on the contrary, one organ of the body, like the shin or the thigh, is greater than the whole measure of place of the entire head.
